name: Galileo
tagline: MCP-Native Agent Eval vs SDK-Instrumented Enterprise AI Observability
oneLine: An observability, evaluation, and guardrail platform for GenAI and agentic applications; as of 2026-08-07 it is Splunk Agent Observability.
tldrVendor: Galileo is an observability, evaluation, and guardrail platform for GenAI and agentic applications, logged through its SDK and scored with out-of-the-box or custom metrics. As of August 7, 2026 it is Splunk Agent Observability, following Cisco's acquisition.

rows.vendor: Python/TypeScript SDK: GalileoLogger, @log decorator, wrapped OpenAI client, LangChain callback; plus OpenTelemetry.
rows.quote: You can decorate or wrap functions with the log decorator to have spans created automatically.

rows.vendor: Enterprise plan lists hosted, VPC, or on-prem deployment; Free and Pro tiers are hosted.
In-process SDK instrumentation; SDK integrations capture prompts and responses without explicit logging code.
rows.quote: Galileo's third-party SDK integrations automatically capture prompts, responses, and performance metrics without requiring you to add explicit logging code throughout your application.

rows.vendor: Out-of-the-box metrics plus custom LLM-as-a-judge or code-based metrics; Luna-2 small language models score at scale.
rows.quote: You can then expand these metrics with custom metrics, using LLM-as-a-judge, or custom code-based metrics.

rows.vendor: Experiment comparison shows cost per response and metric cost, plus input/output token counts and latency.
rows.quote: Galileo allows you to compare up to five different experiments, showing the difference in outputs, metrics, latency, and token usage.

rows.vendor: Ships an MCP server (api.galileo.ai/mcp/http/mcp) for IDEs: datasets, prompt templates, experiments, log-stream signals.
rows.quote: The Galileo MCP server works with both Cursor and VS Code.

rows.vendor: Platform is proprietary (paid tiers); the galileo-python SDK on GitHub is under the Apache License 2.0.
Cisco acquisition announced 2026-04-09, completed per Splunk; as of 2026-08-07 Galileo is Splunk Agent Observability.
rows.quote: As of August 7, 2026, Galileo is now Splunk Agent Observability.

rows.vendor: Web console at app.galileo.ai with projects and Log streams; a Playground runs experiments in the console.
rows.quote: Open the Log stream for your project in the Galileo console using the URL output to your terminal.

rows.vendor: Integrations: OpenAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, Google ADK, Strands, Vercel AI, Bedrock, OTel.
rows.quote: Automatically log all the steps in your LangChain or LangGraph application with the Galileo callback.

rows.vendor: Prompt templates created, stored and retrieved by name via the SDK for experiments; docs advise versioning them.
rows.quote: Prompts in Galileo allow you to create, store, and reuse LLM prompts across your experiments.

rows.vendor: SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA (BAAs) stated on its trust page; Enterprise plan lists RBAC, SSO, VPC or on-prem deployment.
rows.quote: We maintain SOC 2 Type II certification, demonstrating our commitment to security, availability, processing integrity, confidentiality, and privacy controls.

vendorReasons.text: You need Luna-2 small language models tuned for low-latency, reduced-cost metric evaluation at production scale.
You need an enterprise VPC or on-prem deployment with RBAC, SSO and real-time guardrails.
You need out-of-the-box metrics you can extend with custom LLM-as-a-judge or code-based metrics.
You need SDK integrations for OpenAI, LangChain/LangGraph, CrewAI and OpenTelemetry that capture traces without explicit logging code.
You need a platform with SOC 2 Type II certification and HIPAA Business Associate Agreements.

faq.question: What is the difference between Iris and Galileo?
faq.vendorPart: Galileo is an observability, evaluation, and guardrail platform for GenAI and agentic applications, instrumented through its Python/TypeScript SDK and OpenTelemetry; as of August 7, 2026 it is Splunk Agent Observability.

faq.question: Is Iris better than Galileo for MCP agent evaluation?
faq.vendorPart: Galileo offers Luna-2 small language models for low-latency, reduced-cost metric evaluation, real-time guardrails, and hosted, VPC or on-prem enterprise deployment.
